chapter: Family, the reunion retold and sound effects
title: The Long Valley reunion retold
summary: Virginia retells how the Rykers brought Doc's tapes of Goldkette men and took her and her sister Hazel to the Donahoe Bix festival, where they met Chauncey, Paul Mertz and Bill Challis.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: And Norma and Doc Ryker were also instrumental in my meeting with Chauncey after 1927.
How was that?
That was through the Bix Beiderbecke Festival that was held at Bill Donahoe's home.
In Long Valley, New Jersey
In Long Valley.
Yeah, Long Valley.
You told me earlier exactly how it was. You walked into the kitchen.
Yes.
Of Bill Donaho's house?

No, Norma and Doc Ryker were coming up from Florida to attend this Bix Beiderbecke festival. And I had invited them to stop at our home because we had kept up our correspondence through approximately 40 some years of Christmas cards. And our communication has stayed intact all these years. And I had invited them to come and visit us en route. And when they arrived, they told us what Doc was working on. And Doc had been interviewing all the Goldkett men. And they came to my home and played these tapes for us. And then after, my sister Hazel, she and I are the only surviving members of our generation, of the Horvath, well there are younger people. There are nephews and nieces.
Uh huh.
In the Horvath family, from my brother George's family.
Uh huh. Now let me bring you back. You walked into the...You were at the Bill Donahoe Bix festival.
Norma called Bill Donahoe and asked if my sister Hazel and I could attend this festival.
Right.
And they were delighted when they heard we were Charlie Horvath's sisters.
Right.
So we went up to Long Valley with the Rykers. And when I walked into the kitchen...
The kitchen of Bill Donahoe's house?
Bill Donahoe's home. I said, is anyone here from the Goldkette orchestra? And there were I think four or five members standing right in the kitchen.
Who were they? Do you remember?
Well yes, one was Paul Mertz.
Paul Mertz.
Paul Mertz and Chauncey Morehouse and Phil Challis.
And of course Doc was there with you.
Doc was there. I can't think right now....
And Bill Rank, was he there then?
I can't remember now.
Okay. So of course they were all very excited when they arrived.
They were all very excited and we had a marvelous reunion and gabfest between ourselves.
When was that, do you remember?
The year? No that date is.... 72?
Around there. Okay.
